name: Promethazine hydroxyethyl
summary: Hydroxyethylpromethazine is an antihistamine with anticholinergic properties. It is structurally analogous to promethazine.

pharmacology.text: Hydroxyethylpromethazine is an antihistamine with anticholinergic properties.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Phenothiazine antihistamines like promethazine can cause drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision, dizziness and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它本身所知不多。異丙嗪這類啡噻嗪抗組織胺可能引起嗜睡、口乾、視力模糊、頭暈和意識混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它本身所知不多。异丙嗪这类啡噻嗪抗组织胺可能引起嗜睡、口干、视力模糊、头晕和意识混乱。

fact.en: Like promethazine, it is a phenothiazine, the chemical family that also produced the first antipsychotic, chlorpromazine.
fact.zh: 它和異丙嗪一樣屬於啡噻嗪類，這個化學家族也誕生了第一個抗精神病藥氯普麻。
fact.zhHans: 它和异丙嗪一样属于啡噻嗪类，这个化学家族也诞生了第一个抗精神病药氯普麻。
